subject: Kuhesabu / Arithmetic

activities.learning_activity: (a) Identify the concept of numbers using objects in the environment
activities.assessment_criteria: The concept of numbers using objects in the environment has been identified
suggested_resources: Videos building the concept of numbers

activities.learning_activity: (b) Identify numbers from 1-100 in digits and words
activities.assessment_criteria: Numbers from 1-100 in digits and words have been identified

activities.learning_activity: (c) Arrange numbers in sequence from 1-100
activities.assessment_criteria: Numbers in sequence from 1-100 have been arranged

activities.learning_activity: (a) Identify numbers into tens and units
activities.assessment_criteria: Numbers into tens and units have been identified

activities.learning_activity: (b) Use objects/ICT to master the concept of addition
activities.assessment_criteria: The concept of addition has been built using objects/ICT

activities.learning_activity: (c) Add numbers to get a sum not exceeding 99
activities.assessment_criteria: Numbers have been added to get a sum not exceeding 99

activities.learning_activity: (d) Use objects/ICT to master the concept of subtraction
activities.assessment_criteria: The concept of subtraction has been built using objects/ICT

activities.learning_activity: (e) Subtract numbers not exceeding 99
activities.assessment_criteria: Numbers have been subtracted for quantities not exceeding 99

activities.learning_activity: (a) Identify basic shapes
activities.assessment_criteria: Basic shapes have been identified
suggested_resources: cards and picture charts of shapes

activities.learning_activity: (a) Identifying numbers in hundreds
activities.assessment_criteria: Numbers in hundreds have been identified
suggested_resources: Videos and recorded texts related to mathematical operations

activities.learning_activity: (b) Adding numbers to get a total not exceeding 999
activities.assessment_criteria: Numbers have been added to get a total not exceeding 999

activities.learning_activity: (c) Subtracting numbers not exceeding 999
activities.assessment_criteria: Numbers not exceeding 999 have been subtracted

activities.learning_activity: (d) Using objects/ICT to master the concept of multiplication as adding equal groups
activities.assessment_criteria: The concept of multiplication as adding equal groups using objects/ICT has been built

activities.learning_activity: (e) Multiplying single-digit numbers to get a product not exceeding 100
activities.assessment_criteria: A single-digit number has been multiplied to get a product not exceeding 100

activities.learning_activity: (f) Using objects/ICT to master the concept of division as subtracting equal groups
activities.assessment_criteria: The concept of division as subtracting equal groups using objects/ICT has been built

activities.learning_activity: (g) Dividing numbers not exceeding 100 without a remainder
activities.assessment_criteria: Numbers not exceeding 100 have been divided without a remainder

activities.learning_activity: (a) Identifying the concept of fractions using real objects and ICT (whole, half, quarter, third, two-thirds, etc.)
activities.assessment_criteria: The concept of fractions using real objects and ICT (whole, half, quarter, third, two-thirds, etc.) has been identified
suggested_resources: picture cards and charts and videos related to the concept of fractions

activities.learning_activity: (b) Representing fractions using numbers (1/4, 1/2, etc.)
activities.assessment_criteria: Fractions using numbers (1/4, 1/2, etc.) have been represented

activities.learning_activity: (c) Applying measurement skills in various contexts
activities.assessment_criteria: Measurement skills in various contexts have been applied

activities.learning_activity: (d) Using basic shapes to create various shapes
activities.assessment_criteria: Basic shapes to create various shapes have been used

translation_note: English rendering of the Kiswahili TIE syllabus, for English-medium schools. Not TIE's own wording — see translation_of for the verbatim source.
